work.description: The instrument extends violet stockings to Modena canons; protocol, grant, Non obstantibus and closing are all present. LF1080 is the source citation, LF1083 the next page heading. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF1000–1000; the source closing at LF1074–1077 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima quarta februar. millesimo octingentesimo quadragesimo, pontificatus No- stri anno decimo..  Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
